description: Quantifies how far the LAFA eval band (v227->v230) moves the positive label set relative to the bench-v1 grid band (v226->v230). Computed read-only against the PROTEA DB on 2026-06-04.

band_shift.note: Pairs that became true between v226 and v227 (Aug->Sep 2025) are label=1 in the bench-v1 eval.parquet but must NOT count as newly-true under the LAFA v227 band. ~37% of the grid's positive labels are outside the LAFA band.

queries.newly_true_v226_to_v230: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT protein_accession, go_term_id FROM protein_go_annotation WHERE annotation_set_id='<v230>' EXCEPT SELECT protein_accession, go_term_id FROM protein_go_annotation WHERE annotation_set_id='<v226>') x;
queries.newly_true_v227_to_v230: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT protein_accession, go_term_id FROM protein_go_annotation WHERE annotation_set_id='<v230>' EXCEPT SELECT protein_accession, go_term_id FROM protein_go_annotation WHERE annotation_set_id='<v227>') x;
